name: rootview
description: Self-hosted review tracking for field-service teams: an NFC tag or QR code per technician, Google review matching, a leaderboard, rewards, and a separate app for techs. Runs free on Cloudflare.

scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy --no-bundle --branch main --commit-dirty=true
scripts.test: esbuild src/lib/match.ts src/lib/util.ts src/lib/geo.ts src/lib/theme.ts src/lib/totp.ts src/lib/crypto.ts src/lib/assets.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=neutral --outdir=.test-build --log-level=warning && node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/*.test.mjs
